summary: Tested Live Driver Markers end to end. Backend GET /api/express/drivers/nearby: 16/16 pytest pass. Covered validation (422 for missing params, lat/lng out of range, country length 1 or 3, radius 0 or 16, non-numeric), response shape (radius_km, count, drivers, stale_after_s=60, as_of), the driver going online and pinging (count=1, lat/lng rounded to 28.616/77.211, distance 0.3 km, payload keys only vehicle_type/lat/lng/distance_km, no ids/phones), lowercase country, far origin Mumbai = 0, country CI = 0, radius 0.1 = 0 and 15 = 1, offline = 0, and stale after 63 s without a ping = 0. Website /send at 390 mobile: IN starts with 'Aucun chauffeur disponible à proximité pour le moment'. With the driver going online after load, the chip changed to '1 chauffeur(s) disponible(s) à proximité' and a yellow bike DriverPin appeared about 30 s later without a reload (polling works). The old fake markers are gone. Desktop 1440 IN shows the chip and marker in the map panel; CI shows 0. EN texts: '1 driver(s) available nearby' and 'No drivers available nearby right now'. Admin show_drivers=false for IN (PATCH homepage-sections) hides the chip and markers on mobile and desktop and sends no nearby requests. It was set back to true. Native Expo preview: the chip sits on cms-send-map-hps_send_ci_010_send_map_hero (CI, 0 count, request lat=5.36 lng=-4.0083). With baked_active_address set to an IN address, the request uses country=IN lat=28.6139 lng=77.209 and shows '1 chauffeur(s) disponible(s) à proximité' and '1 driver(s) available nearby' (EN). Regression: SEND pickup, tiles and trust render on website and native; native SHOP/MART/FOOD CMS homes render; /send/track live tracking page renders with map, LIVE and driver card, no page errors. Driver set offline at the end (nearby count 0).

minor.issue: Pre-filter only limits latitude (BETWEEN lat±deg); longitude is not limited, so with 200+ drivers in a latitude band, the LIMIT 200 without ORDER BY can drop nearby drivers. Add a longitude bound (deg/cos(lat)) or ORDER BY distance.

issues: The FR empty-state chip 'Aucun chauffeur disponible à proximité pour le moment' wraps to 2 lines inside the fixed h-8 pill and reaches the right edge of the map. Use a shorter copy, whitespace-nowrap + truncate, or h-auto py-1.

critical_code_review_comments: nearby_drivers eligibility matches dispatch (module express, active, is_available, deleted_at null, linked_driver_id, last_seen_at >= now-60s). Good.

Web useNearbyDrivers uses the browser geolocation as the origin when there is no active address. A user whose GPS is outside the selected country gets count 0 even if drivers are near the city center. This is acceptable, but note that the map defaultCenter does not follow the origin.
Location pings alone do not bring an offline driver back online. This is correct and was confirmed while testing.
